body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.58 (naive base rate 0.50) that: Godrej Properties FY27 booking value is ≥₹40,000 cr. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (23-Oct-2026): H1 bookings ₹16,669 cr (+7%; 43% of the ₹39,000 cr FY27 guidance) with only a third of launches done; Q2 bookings ₹8,008 cr; H2 launch pipeline ~₹32,000 cr (Bandra, Sector 63A Gurugram, Thane, Verano). Chairperson Pirojsha Godrej: H2 estimate ₹22,500–25,000 cr; 'We hope to cross INR40,000 crores this year.' Collections H1 ₹9,666 cr (+25%). Track record (Q4 FY26 call, May-2026): FY26 bookings ₹34,171 cr = 105% of guidance; deliveries 121% of guidance; BD 200%+ of guidance. Risks named: GRAP/air-quality construction bans in NCR and Mumbai. Reasoning: GPL has beaten its booking guidance in recent years and the H2 pipeline is large; ₹40,000 cr needs ~₹23,300 cr in H2, inside management's range. Launch slippage is the main failure mode (half of H1 launches slipped). Above base. Resolution: YES if Godrej Properties' reported FY27 (Apr-2026–Mar-2027) booking value (sales bookings), per its Q4 FY27 operational update or results presentation, is ≥₹40,000 cr. Source: Godrej Properties Q4 FY27 business update / investor presentation (NSE). Resolve by 2027-04-30; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Indian developers hit 'slightly above guidance' targets (here 103% of guidance) roughly half the time.

title: Paper call: Godrej Properties FY27 booking value is ≥₹40,000 cr
